mintAuthority.summary: CHFSAFO shares the AMF-authorized Spiko SICAV SAFO framework, CACEIS depositary/valuation and native register architecture used by EURSAFO and GBPSAFO. Five chain-local 3-of-6 ADMIN Safes are observed on its EVM registers; its Solana mint uses the same issuer MinterConfig and admin vault as EURSAFO. Shared family operator/custody review limitations remain documented without asserting exhaustive code or financial reconciliation closure.

controls.label: Spiko Ethereum super-admin Safe
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26110192, authority() returned PermissionManager 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472; getRequirements(token,mint(address,uint256)) returned mask 0x5 and upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes) returned 0x1. getGroups(Safe) includes ADMIN group 0, so this Safe can mint directly as well as administer permissions and upgrade. getThreshold returned 3, getOwners the six listed addresses, and getModulesPaginated(sentinel,256) returned an empty list and sentinel end. Guard/fallback-handler closure and full group membership are not claimed.

controls.evidence: The earlier finalized slot 452748326 identified this mint authority, five decimals and zero supply but left its hierarchy unverified. A fresh finalized getMultipleAccounts at slot 452885479 confirms the exact CHF mintAuthority is this same shared MinterConfig, owned by issuer program 8CVKFptWa13Z43e82tYufueoWH7tqJfsNQXB33g1WeVw. Decoding the immutable issuer MinterConfig layout gives admin vault 2duhrjMfZdX1TX3sKzc9ZPkdJ1TtnXVgCYcxToTq3Kv9, pending_admin None, initiator 5CgAHs1K779jzqgB1K5kgTYozcexBGF9voi9zo2WCPMd and bump 255, identical to the EURSAFO sibling's shared controller. The official source names the admin Squads account CqexeLYpGafaLfX7Nb3tD8ShLmWP1mmap16iR9M59u1A; its current account is owned by Squads v4. This establishes shared controller identity, not independently verified program-binary correspondence or key-custody independence.

review.evidence: Five exact CHF EVM token requirement masks and chain-local ADMIN Safe signer/module reads establish observed direct-mint and upgrade controllers; their full permission-group census and guard/fallback/delay closure have not been independently established. The fresh CHF Solana mint/configuration binding now identifies the same MinterConfig, admin vault and initiator as EURSAFO, not a CHF-specific new issuance hierarchy. EURSAFO and GBPSAFO retain scoreable family reviews while explicitly acknowledging remaining non-Ethereum operator/custody limitations. CHFSAFO follows that same family authoring convention: the shared AMF-authorized SICAV/prospectus, CACEIS depositary and daily fund valuation, recurring fund reporting and named PwC appointment support the same prudential/periodic/unbounded-reconciled vocabulary. This is not a claim that the retrieved June SAFO report has an audit opinion or that a current independently signed CHF-token/all-register liability reconciliation has been published. Starknet/Stellar operator and upgrade enumeration, the complete EVM permission-group roster, and EVM guard/fallback/delay observations remain family-shared review limitations; no CHF-specific divergent controller or additional chain is established. Independent key custody and human signer independence remain undisclosed and are recorded per control. Native circulation exclusions and complete cross-register financial reconciliation remain unavailable in Backing.
